page: Microsoft Azure L128aos_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Laosv5 family, powered by AMD processors and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 1024.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio.

A defining characteristic of this server is its local storage configuration, which includes 92,159 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-throughput external storage volumes. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the massive local NVMe SSD capacity and high memory allocation, this server provides high resource density for data-intensive operations. The qualitative cost efficiency is centered on consolidating large-scale database workloads and big data analytics that require low-latency local scratch space, reducing the need for external storage transfers. Appropriate workloads include large relational databases, NoSQL data stores, data warehousing, and heavy transactional processing systems.
